about.title: Building Excellence Since 1986
about.paragraph1: Founded in 1986 in the heart of Tangier, ITI Institute (Institut Trans Informatique) has established itself as a cornerstone of technical education in Northern Morocco. Our mission is to provide high-quality vocational training tailored to the evolving demands of the job market.
about.paragraph2: We are proud to offer a structured learning environment where practical skills meet theoretical rigor, ensuring our graduates are ready for successful careers.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about ITI Institute, our training programs, and the admission process.
faq.q1: What training programs does ITI Institute offer in Tangier?
faq.a1: ITI Institute offers Specialized Technician diplomas in Navigation & Logistics Management and Business Management (2 years), as well as continuing education in Web Development (6 months), Accounting (4 months), Office Applications, and Accounting Software (SAGE, SAP).
faq.a2: Yes, Institut Trans Informatique (ITI) is a vocational training institution accredited by the Moroccan State. The diplomas awarded are officially recognized and enable direct professional entry into national and international job markets.
faq.q3: How do I register for the 2026-2027 academic session?
faq.a3: Applications are submitted online via our application form on the website. Fill in your personal details, select your program, and our admissions team will contact you within 24 hours to schedule an interview. You can also call us at 05 39 93 95 37.
faq.q4: What is the duration of programs at ITI?
faq.a4: Specialized Technician diplomas last 2 years. Continuing education courses range from 4 months (Accounting) to 6 months (Web Development). Practical office and accounting software modules are short-term and tailored for active professionals.
faq.q5: Where is ITI Institute located and how can I contact them?
faq.a5: ITI Institute is located at 42, Rue de Fès in Tangier, Morocco. You can contact us by phone at 05 39 93 95 37 or 06 68 43 48 95, by email at instituttrans@gmail.com, or via the contact form on our website.
